siteGuide.description: The guide identifies Freshness and Clarity Hall on the east bank of the pond below the Naval Training School.

limitations: The photo establishes the name plaque, lattice doors and the circular opening seen along the center bay. Width, depth, roof height and unseen rear details are estimates.

The approximate center is aligned to two PMTiles pavilion footprints, then moved 3.5 m inland to retain clearance from the mapped pond. The roof and quay establish a west-southwest-facing facade. Canopy and approximate water boundaries limit absolute positioning.

imagery.observation: Clear roof, pale shore terrace and corridor to the north. The ridge bearing is measured from this view.
The hall remains on the projecting east bank below the other two pavilion roofs.
Leaf-off image shows the same west terrace and roof mass. Shadows obscure part of the edge.
